test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion loss and gradient computation using gtn forward_score and backward
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion loss and gradient computation using gtn compose and forward_score
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path decoding using gtn viterbi_path on composed emissions and transitions
create_emissions_graph: create a linear graph with emission weights from a vector using gtn linear_graph and set_weights
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from target labels and a blank symbol using gtn Graph add_node and add_arc
